items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Marylou' in a list of musicians (Chick Corea, Keith Jarrett, Cecil Taylor) by the interviewer, but the interviewee (Wilbur B. Ware, Sr) does not respond with any personal anecdote, relationship, or specific interaction regarding Marylou.

ctx.x: You know, what's that about? You know? But that's where it's going. It's all about money. In order to play on the big concert stage, if you're not playing the rock thing, you've got to play the thing like Chick Corea or Keith Jarrett or any of those groups -- Cecil Taylor -- you know.
Look at this thing they did not too long ago -- Marylou and --
